NINJA_SLAYER_POWER_KARATE_POWER.title: Karate
NINJA_SLAYER_POWER_KARATE_POWER.descript:
Whenever your attack deals damage, deal additional damage equal to your stacks to ALL enemies hit, then lose 1 [gold]Karate[/gold].
An attack that hits ALL enemies only consumes 1 stack per hit.

An attack that hits ALL enemies only consumes 1 stack per hit.

NINJA_SLAYER_POWER_IAI_POWER.description:
After {Amount} more {Amount:plural:hit|hits} from attacks, counterattack the attacker.
The counterattack has 0 base damage and benefits from Strength and other attack modifiers.
